main_control.evidence_basis: Accepted/actual joint-velocity divergence, nominal and feedback-induced actuator saturation precede first material load in both saved E30s; trunk(v,J) selection operates but does not imply balance.
main_control.substitution_rule: If saved original files demonstrate an earlier specific interface bug, repair that instead with explicit evidence. Do not stack mechanisms or blindly relabel unchanged r28.

qp.state_error: 36D tangent delta_x with original quaternion convention
qp.objective: .5 eta^T H eta + (s C delta_x)^T eta
qp.s: actual candidate feedback_scaling, not assumed1 at every call
qp.line_search: alpha already in u_ff; never add full Q_u again only at deployment
qp.empty_intersection: explicit infeasible and predeclared minimum-violation restoration with original physical torque clipping
qp.predicted_decrease: recompute for changed policy or record unavailable; do not keep an invalid surprise ratio
qp.limits: Instantaneous feasibility is neither 2ms held-action feasibility nor a closed-loop stability guarantee.
qp.interpolation: Define one consistent H(t),C(t),unconstrained K(t) and same candidate/deployment interpolation; independently interpolating H/C/oldK is not equivalent. Use actual regularization_used. If retaining old interpolated K as target, define corresponding QP linear term and disclose difference from original Q_ux.

resources.preferred_during_gpu_task: 2x12 main MPC workers plus1-2 GPU host threads
resources.oversubscription: allowed modestly; measure useful throughput and contention, not thread count or VRAM fullness

gpu_task.preferred_first_backend: MJX-JAX FP64 batch dynamics/finite differences and candidate rollout with same problem; MPX as architecture reference
gpu_task.parallel_dimensions: nodes x perturbation directions; preserve ten-substep prefix derivatives and terminal risk semantics
gpu_task.CPU_plant: keep original Go2/TM02 CPU ground truth; no hidden material input to predictor
gpu_task.version_rule: begin saved-state r28 parity if needed; when targeting r29 use an explicitly matched r29 CPU reference. Never mix versions in a parity/speed claim.
test_sources: B nominal saturation and first large feedback
test_sequence: one and ten substeps with original control/contacts
fixed full candidate outputs and ranking
one whole planner call including transfer and synchronization
timing: existing six internal solver timers with units
steady-state p50/p95 on fixed bounded repeats
gpu_task.numerical_acceptance: record raw per-variable errors and predeclare units/tolerances from original FD step and model precision; do not relax physical qualification thresholds
gpu_task.MJWarp_caveat: official FP32/no automatic differentiation/throughput focus; original1e-6 FD is not automatically equivalent
gpu_task.optional_integration: only after matched same-problem numerical alignment and complete backend exist: frozen own W39 policy and original CPU plant, separate short closed-loop <=original E30 duration, marked GPU integration only; no formal qualification or automatic higher ladder
gpu_task.dependencies: reuse if compatible; necessary new GPU dependencies isolated and pinned; do not alter main MuJoCo3.2.3 ABI/environment
gpu_task.completion_rule: deliver runnable code and actual results at completed layer, exact remaining interface/precision limit; no claim of full GPU MPC if only a batch layer exists
gpu_task.test_authorization: Latest user explicitly authorizes third GPU implementation/testing; overrides historical two-slot/no-GPU-benchmark restriction for this task only
do_not_do: third PPO lineage or merging branch optimizers
report kernel speed as full control realtime

budgets.gpu_clock: create once at first actual GPU task start; finish early when tests complete

diagnostics.all_episode_core_records: preserve all requested original feedback/planner/reference/execution and new rollout evidence
diagnostics.new_full_horizon_scope: selected event windows only, each retained plan once before buffers reused; explicitly enumerate full-horizon coverage
diagnostics.events: nominal first raw-PD saturation, feedback-added saturation, max|rawKdx|>.5rad, target clipping, first material load, domain exit, nonfoot load, QP infeasibility/failure/restoration, trunk restoration, terminal; merged [-.10,+.20]s and terminal .10s; logging only, no physical stop changes
full_plan_fields: first20ms node and ten-substep PD/contact/material coverage
diagnostics.representation: lossless binary/compression, bounded in-memory event ring; do not repeat full matrices in500Hz action lines
diagnostics.historical_missing: full accepted/K never recorded in r27/r28; cannot reconstruct as original evidence
per_action_live_fields: QP solution and active set/constraint type
raw/final actions and raw/clipped PD torque
information sufficient to reconstruct active-boundary state derivatives
diagnostics.plan_vs_live_K: Plan reference K is not the full effective online-QP Jacobian. Store frozen H/C/referenceK once per retained plan, live state/active-set per action; reconstruct effective Jacobian without duplicating432 elements each tick.
diagnostics.coverage_boundary: Include every plan referenced by earliest pre-window action even if origin precedes window; no old spatial gate. Record incomplete beginning/end coverage; do not continue physics after termination to fill post-window.
